notes: bug**: the local web server that backs the terminal (Settings save, data tabs, charts) now runs as a **persistent detached daemon** with a stable port + token (`~/.orrery/server.json`), so pages keep working when the plugin process is cycled by the host. Previously the server died with the plugin process, orphaning any open tab. Falls back to the legacy in-process server where a daemon can't be spawned (no regression). - **⚙ tab is now labeled
